title: Killer In The Keep
premise: A storm isolates four to eight adventurers inside a dangerous fantasy estate. One player is secretly the killer. Investigators explore the Keep, complete objectives, question NPCs, gather evidence, survive monsters and traps, and identify the killer, murder weapon, and crime location before the killer completes a ritual or escapes with the relic.

dndMode.exploration: real-time ground movement snapped to 5-foot cells
dndMode.diagonalRule: five feet per adjacent diagonal cell by default; host may enable alternating 5/10

investigators: correctly accuse the killer, weapon, and room
complete all major objectives before the ritual resolves
killer: control the vote by reducing investigators
escape by a ground-accessible route with the relic

multiplayerMode: Server-authoritative polling through the configured Google Apps Script deployment.
